scope: All nine bibliography entries dated 2026; primary public records and the specified content, not an independent replication of their findings.

entries.title: Beyond Task Completion: Revealing Corrupt Success in LLM Agents through Procedure-Aware Evaluation
entries.characterization: Separates outcome utility from procedural integrity; its gating changes evaluation scores. The manuscript distinguishes this from blocking a write before execution.
entries.status: public record accessible; title/authors and scoped characterization checked

entries.title: Real-Time Detection and Repair of LLM Agent Failures
entries.characterization: Telemetry monitoring, deterministic verification and rollback/re-run repair are described. External CPU reproduction in our archive is a separate evidence claim, not a new replication performed for this citation check.
entries.status: public record accessible; title/authors and scoped characterization checked

entries.title: PrefixGuard: Online Failure Warning and Trace-Grounded Diagnosis for LLM Agents
entries.characterization: Learned-event online warnings are linked to finite-state diagnosis. The manuscript uses the v2 title and all seven listed authors.
entries.status: public record accessible; title/authors and scoped characterization checked

entries.title: ReliabilityBench: Evaluating LLM Agent Reliability Under Production-Like Stress Conditions
entries.characterization: Repeated execution, semantic perturbations and controlled tool/API faults support the stress-testing comparison.
entries.status: public record accessible; title/authors and scoped characterization checked

entries.title: AgentRx: Diagnosing AI Agent Failures from Execution Trajectories
entries.characterization: Constraint synthesis and trace-based localization of a critical failure step support the diagnostic comparison.
entries.status: public record accessible; title/authors and scoped characterization checked

entries.title: AgentCheck: A Reproduce-Intervene-Mitigate Workbench for LLM Agents over MCP
entries.characterization: Controlled tool-response perturbation, cached replay and mitigation checks support the workbench comparison.
entries.status: public record accessible; title/authors and scoped characterization checked

entries.title: From Confident Closing to Silent Failure: Characterizing False Success in LLM Agents
entries.characterization: Examines claimed completion despite unsuccessful environment state. This differs from our successful reference endpoints with omitted procedures.
entries.status: public record accessible; title/authors and scoped characterization checked

entries.title: Ajar: Measuring Open Privilege in Agent Defenses
entries.characterization: Required, permitted and excess candidate calls are evaluated at reference-plan decision points. Our actor-generated proposal corpus and live continuation do not measure all unproposed excess privileges.
entries.status: public record accessible; title/authors and scoped characterization checked

entries.title: AgentSpec: Customizable Runtime Enforcement for Safe and Reliable LLM Agents
entries.characterization: Specifies a language of runtime triggers, predicates and enforcement. The 2025 preprint has an ICSE 2026 journal reference on the public record; the bibliography year 2026 refers to that venue.
entries.status: public record accessible; title/authors and scoped characterization checked
